$comment: Persona consistency suite (plan-persona.md §4.1): 20 scenarios x 5 turns. bp-* = boundary probes (one per card boundary, 3+ escalation angles); dg-* = user-is-clearly-wrong scenarios. trait_tags close the loop with persona.json l1.traits.scenario_tag — every tag must be covered by at least one scenario (checked by eval tests). User turns are fixed scripts; assistant replies come from the backend under test.
